quote: When a large feedforward neural network is trained on a small training set, it typically performs poorly on held-out test data.
claim: 论文要解决的问题是：当大型前馈神经网络在小型训练集上训练时，通常会在留出测试数据上表现很差，这种过拟合需要被大幅减少 [p1]。

quote: the feature detectors have been tuned to work well together on the training data but not on the test data.
claim: 原文指出，过拟合的原因之一是特征检测器被调校为在训练数据上协同工作，而在测试数据上不能 [p2]。

quote: On each presentation of each training case, each hidden unit is randomly omitted from the network with a probability of 0.5, so a hidden unit cannot rely on other hidden units being present.
claim: 论文提出用 dropout 来防止训练数据上的复杂共适应：在每次呈现每个训练样本时，每个隐藏单元以 0.5 的概率被随机从网络中省略，因此隐藏单元不能依赖其他隐藏单元的存在 [p3]。

quote: we set an upper bound on the L2 norm of the incoming weight vector for each individual hidden unit.
claim: 训练使用标准随机梯度下降，但把通常的权重惩罚改为对每个隐藏单元输入权重向量的 L2 范数设置上界，若权重更新违反该约束则通过除法重新归一化 [p4]。

quote: At test time, we use the “mean network” that contains all of the hidden units but with their outgoing weights halved
claim: 测试时使用包含所有隐藏单元但输出权重减半的“mean network” [p5]。

quote: It contains 60,000 28x28 training images of individual hand written digits and 10,000 test images.
claim: 论文在多个基准数据集上验证 dropout：MNIST 手写数字（60,000 训练、10,000 测试图像）[p6]、TIMIT 干净语音识别 [p8]、CIFAR-10 物体识别（50,000 训练、10,000 测试图像）[p10]、ImageNet 物体识别 [p11] 以及 Reuters 文档分类（201,369 训练和 201,369 测试文档，50 个互斥类别）[p13]。

quote: We then applied dropout to TIMIT, a widely used benchmark for recognition of clean speech with a small vocabulary.
claim: 论文在多个基准数据集上验证 dropout：MNIST 手写数字（60,000 训练、10,000 测试图像）[p6]、TIMIT 干净语音识别 [p8]、CIFAR-10 物体识别（50,000 训练、10,000 测试图像）[p10]、ImageNet 物体识别 [p11] 以及 Reuters 文档分类（201,369 训练和 201,369 测试文档，50 个互斥类别）[p13]。

quote: CIFAR-10 is a benchmark task for object recognition.
claim: 论文在多个基准数据集上验证 dropout：MNIST 手写数字（60,000 训练、10,000 测试图像）[p6]、TIMIT 干净语音识别 [p8]、CIFAR-10 物体识别（50,000 训练、10,000 测试图像）[p10]、ImageNet 物体识别 [p11] 以及 Reuters 文档分类（201,369 训练和 201,369 测试文档，50 个互斥类别）[p13]。

quote: ImageNet is an extremely challenging object recognition dataset consisting of thousands of high-resolution images of thousands of classes of object.
claim: 论文在多个基准数据集上验证 dropout：MNIST 手写数字（60,000 训练、10,000 测试图像）[p6]、TIMIT 干净语音识别 [p8]、CIFAR-10 物体识别（50,000 训练、10,000 测试图像）[p10]、ImageNet 物体识别 [p11] 以及 Reuters 文档分类（201,369 训练和 201,369 测试文档，50 个互斥类别）[p13]。

quote: We created training and test sets each containing 201,369 documents from 50 mutually exclusive classes.
claim: 论文在多个基准数据集上验证 dropout：MNIST 手写数字（60,000 训练、10,000 测试图像）[p6]、TIMIT 干净语音识别 [p8]、CIFAR-10 物体识别（50,000 训练、10,000 测试图像）[p10]、ImageNet 物体识别 [p11] 以及 Reuters 文档分类（201,369 训练和 201,369 测试文档，50 个互斥类别）[p13]。

quote: The input to the net is 21 adjacent frames with an advance of 10ms per frame.
claim: 在 TIMIT 上，网络输入为 21 个相邻帧，使用 4 个全连接隐藏层、每层 4000 单元和 185 个 softmax 输出单元 [p9]。

quote: CIFAR-10 is a benchmark task for object recognition.
claim: 在 CIFAR-10 和 ImageNet 上使用卷积神经网络，并在最后隐藏层使用 dropout [p10][p11]。

quote: ImageNet is an extremely challenging object recognition dataset consisting of thousands of high-resolution images of thousands of classes of object.
claim: 在 CIFAR-10 和 ImageNet 上使用卷积神经网络，并在最后隐藏层使用 dropout [p10][p11]。

quote: the best published result for a standard feedforward neural network is 160 errors on the test set.
claim: 在 MNIST 上，不使用任何技巧的标准前馈神经网络最佳已发表结果为 160 个测试错误，使用 50% dropout 和每个隐藏单元输入权重的独立 L2 约束可降至约 130 个错误，再对 20% 像素做 dropout 可进一步降至约 110 个错误 [p6]。

quote: Without dropout, the recognition rate is $22.7$ % and with dropout this improves to $19.7$ %
claim: 在 TIMIT 上，不使用 dropout 的识别率为 22.7%，使用 dropout 后提高到 19.7%，这是不使用说话人身份信息的方法中的记录 [p9]。

quote: The best published error rate on the test set, without using transformed data, is 18.5%.
claim: 在 CIFAR-10 上，不使用变换数据的最佳已发表错误率为 18.5%，作者用卷积网络达到 16.6%，在最后隐藏层使用 dropout 后达到 15.6% [p10]。

quote: We achieved comparable performance of 48.6% error using a single neural network
claim: 在 ImageNet 上，作者用单个神经网络达到 48.6% 错误，在第六隐藏层使用 50% dropout 后降至创纪录的 42.4% [p11]。

quote: A feedforward neural network with 2 fully connected layers of 2000 hidden units trained with backpropagation gets 31.05% error on the test set.
claim: 在 Reuters 上，两层 2000 隐藏单元的前馈网络测试错误为 31.05%，使用 50% dropout 后降至 29.62% [p13]。

quote: When deeper networks are able to start converging, a degradation problem has been exposed: with the network depth increasing, accuracy gets saturated (which might be unsurprising) and then degrades rapidly.
claim: 论文要解决的问题是：当更深的网络能够开始收敛时，出现的退化问题——随着网络深度增加，准确率饱和并迅速下降，且这种退化并非由过拟合引起，向适当深的模型添加更多层反而导致更高的训练误差 [S1.p3]。

quote: The existence of this constructed solution indicates that a deeper model should produce no higher training error than its shallower counterpart.
claim: 作者指出，按照构造，更深模型不应比其较浅对应模型产生更高的训练误差，但实验表明当前求解器无法找到与构造解相当或更好的解 [S1.p4]。

quote: Instead of hoping each few stacked layers directly fit a desired underlying mapping, we explicitly let these layers fit a residual mapping.
claim: 论文提出深度残差学习框架，让堆叠的非线性层拟合残差映射 F(x):=H(x)-x，而不是直接拟合期望的底层映射 H(x)，原始映射被重新表述为 F(x)+x [S1.p5]。

quote: The formulation of $\mathcal{F}(\mathbf{x})+\mathbf{x}$ can be realized by feedforward neural networks with “shortcut connections” (Fig. 2).
claim: 该表述通过前馈神经网络的“捷径连接”实现，捷径连接执行恒等映射，其输出与堆叠层的输出相加，不增加额外参数或计算复杂度 [S1.p6]。

quote: If this is not the case ( e.g., when changing the input/output channels), we can perform a linear projection $W_{s}$ by the shortcut connections to match the dimensions
claim: 当输入输出维度相同时直接使用恒等捷径，维度增加时可用零填充或投影捷径匹配维度 [S3.SS2.p3]。

quote: We evaluate our method on the ImageNet 2012 classification dataset that consists of 1000 classes.
claim: 论文在ImageNet 2012分类数据集上评估方法，该数据集包含1000类，模型在128万张训练图像上训练，在5万张验证图像上评估，并报告top-1和top-5错误率 [S4.SS1.p1]。

quote: We conducted more studies on the CIFAR-10 dataset, which consists of 50k training images and 10k testing images in 10 classes.
claim: 在CIFAR-10数据集上进行了更多研究，该数据集包含5万张训练图像和1万张测试图像，共10类 [S4.SS2.p1]。

quote: We adopt Faster R-CNN as the detection method.
claim: 此外，还在PASCAL VOC 2007/2012和MS COCO上采用Faster R-CNN进行目标检测基线实验 [S4.SS3.p1]。

quote: The results in Table 2 show that the deeper 34-layer plain net has higher validation error than the shallower 18-layer plain net.
claim: 在ImageNet上，34层普通网络比18层普通网络具有更高的验证误差，且34层普通网络在整个训练过程中训练误差都更高 [S4.SS1.p3]。

quote: First, the situation is reversed with residual learning – the 34-layer ResNet is better than the 18-layer ResNet (by 2.8%).
claim: 使用残差学习后情况反转：34层ResNet优于18层ResNet（约2.8%），且34层ResNet相比其普通对应网络将top-1误差降低约3.5% [S4.SS1.p6][S4.SS1.p7]。

quote: Second, compared to its plain counterpart, the 34-layer ResNet reduces the top-1 error by 3.5% (Table 2), resulting from the successfully reduced training error
claim: 使用残差学习后情况反转：34层ResNet优于18层ResNet（约2.8%），且34层ResNet相比其普通对应网络将top-1误差降低约3.5% [S4.SS1.p6][S4.SS1.p7]。

quote: The 50/101/152-layer ResNets are more accurate than the 34-layer ones by considerable margins (Table 3 and 5).
claim: 50/101/152层ResNet比34层ResNet准确率更高，未观察到退化问题，并从深度增加中获得显著准确率提升 [S4.SS1.p15]。

quote: The deep plain nets suffer from increased depth, and exhibit higher training error when going deeper.
claim: 在CIFAR-10上，深层普通网络同样随深度增加训练误差更高，而ResNet克服了优化困难并在深度增加时表现出准确率提升 [S4.SS2.p4][S4.SS2.p5]。

quote: our ResNets manage to overcome the optimization difficulty and demonstrate accuracy gains when the depth increases.
claim: 在CIFAR-10上，深层普通网络同样随深度增加训练误差更高，而ResNet克服了优化困难并在深度增加时表现出准确率提升 [S4.SS2.p4][S4.SS2.p5]。

quote: this $10^{3}$ -layer network is able to achieve training error $<$ 0.1% (Fig. 6, right). Its test error is still fairly good (7.93%, Table 6).
claim: 1202层网络训练误差低于0.1%，但测试误差为7.93%，差于110层网络 [S4.SS2.p8][S4.SS2.p9]。

quote: The testing result of this 1202-layer network is worse than that of our 110-layer network, although both have similar training error.
claim: 1202层网络训练误差低于0.1%，但测试误差为7.93%，差于110层网络 [S4.SS2.p8][S4.SS2.p9]。

quote: We argue that this is because of overfitting. The 1202-layer network may be unnecessarily large (19.4M) for this small dataset.
claim: 作者指出，1202层网络测试结果差于110层网络，认为这是因为过拟合，该网络对此小数据集可能不必要地大，本文未使用maxout/dropout，仅通过深而窄的架构施加正则化，结合更强正则化可能改善结果，留待未来研究 [S4.SS2.p9]。

quote: The reason for such optimization difficulties will be studied in the future.
claim: 作者还指出，深层普通网络优化困难的原因将在未来研究 [S4.SS1.p4]。

quote: we have not performed multi-scale training because of limited time.
claim: 此外，作者提到多尺度训练因时间有限未进行，多尺度测试也仅用于Fast R-CNN步骤而未用于RPN步骤 [A2.p5]。

quote: This inherently sequential nature precludes parallelization within training examples, which becomes critical at longer sequence lengths, as memory constraints limit batching across examples.
claim: 论文要解决的问题是：循环模型沿序列位置逐步计算，其固有的顺序性阻碍了训练样本内部的并行化，在序列较长时尤为关键 [S1.p2]。

quote: In this work we propose the Transformer, a model architecture eschewing recurrence and instead relying entirely on an attention mechanism to draw global dependencies between input and output.
claim: 作者希望提出一种不依赖循环、完全依靠注意力机制来建立输入输出全局依赖的模型架构 [S1.p4]。

quote: The encoder is composed of a stack of $N=6$ identical layers. Each layer has two sub-layers.
claim: Transformer 沿用编码器-解码器整体结构，编码器和解码器各由 N=6 个相同层堆叠而成，每层包含多头自注意力与逐位置全连接前馈网络，并配有残差连接和层归一化 [S3.SS1.SSS0.Px1.p1][S3.SS1.SSS0.Px2.p1]。

quote: The decoder is also composed of a stack of $N=6$ identical layers.
claim: Transformer 沿用编码器-解码器整体结构，编码器和解码器各由 N=6 个相同层堆叠而成，每层包含多头自注意力与逐位置全连接前馈网络，并配有残差连接和层归一化 [S3.SS1.SSS0.Px1.p1][S3.SS1.SSS0.Px2.p1]。

quote: We compute the dot products of the query with all keys, divide each by $\sqrt{d_{k}}$, and apply a softmax function to obtain the weights on the values.
claim: 注意力采用缩放点积注意力，即对 query 与所有 key 的点积除以 sqrt(d_k) 后做 softmax 加权求和 [S3.SS2.SSS1.p1]；

quote: we found it beneficial to linearly project the queries, keys and values $h$ times with different, learned linear projections
claim: 多头注意力将 query、key、value 线性投影 h 次后并行执行注意力 [S3.SS2.SSS2.p1]。

quote: Since our model contains no recurrence and no convolution, in order for the model to make use of the order of the sequence, we must inject some information about the relative or absolute position of the tokens in the sequence.
claim: 由于模型不含循环和卷积，作者在输入嵌入中加入正弦位置编码以注入位置信息 [S3.SS5.p1]。

quote: We trained on the standard WMT 2014 English-German dataset consisting of about 4.5 million sentence pairs.
claim: 训练数据为 WMT 2014 英德数据集（约 450 万句对）和 WMT 2014 英法数据集（3600 万句） [S5.SS1.p1]。

quote: We trained our models on one machine with 8 NVIDIA P100 GPUs.
claim: 模型在 8 块 NVIDIA P100 GPU 上训练，base 模型训练 100,000 步约 12 小时，big 模型训练 300,000 步约 3.5 天 [S5.SS2.p1]。

quote: We trained a 4-layer transformer with $d_{model}=1024$ on the Wall Street Journal (WSJ) portion of the Penn Treebank, about 40K training sentences.
claim: 作者还在英语成分句法分析任务上验证泛化能力，使用 Penn Treebank 的 WSJ 部分约 40K 训练句，并在半监督设置下使用约 17M 句的语料 [S6.SS3.p2]。

quote: outperforms the best previously reported models (including ensembles) by more than $2.0$ BLEU, establishing a new state-of-the-art BLEU score of $28.4$.
claim: 在 WMT 2014 英德翻译任务上，big 模型比此前最佳模型（含集成）高出 2.0 BLEU 以上，取得 28.4 BLEU 的新最优结果 [S6.SS1.p1]；

quote: our big model achieves a BLEU score of $41.0$, outperforming all of the previously published single models
claim: 在英法任务上 big 模型取得 41.0 BLEU，超过此前所有已发表单模型 [S6.SS1.p2]。

quote: While single-head attention is 0.9 BLEU worse than the best setting, quality also drops off with too many heads.
claim: 模型变体实验显示，单头注意力比最佳设置差 0.9 BLEU，头数过多也会导致质量下降 [S6.SS2.p2]；

quote: we observe that reducing the attention key size $d_{k}$ hurts model quality.
claim: 减小注意力 key 维度 d_k 会损害模型质量 [S6.SS2.p3]；

quote: we observe that reducing the attention key size $d_{k}$ hurts model quality.
claim: 用学习式位置嵌入替换正弦位置编码结果几乎相同 [S6.SS2.p3]。

quote: the Transformer outperforms the BerkeleyParser even when training only on the WSJ training set of 40K sentences.
claim: 在英语成分句法分析上，Transformer 在仅用 WSJ 40K 句训练时也超过了 BerkeleyParser [S6.SS3.p5]。

quote: In the Transformer this is reduced to a constant number of operations, albeit at the cost of reduced effective resolution due to averaging attention-weighted positions, an effect we counteract with Multi-Head Attention
claim: 作者指出，自注意力将任意两位置间的操作数降为常数，但代价是注意力加权位置平均导致有效分辨率降低，他们用多头注意力来抵消这一影响 [S2.p1]。

quote: self-attention could be restricted to considering only a neighborhood of size $r$ in the input sequence centered around the respective output position.
claim: 对于涉及很长序列的任务，作者提出可将自注意力限制在输入序列中以相应输出位置为中心的、大小为 r 的邻域内，并计划在未来工作中进一步研究这一方法 [S4.p4]。

quote: We plan to extend the Transformer to problems involving input and output modalities other than text and to investigate local, restricted attention mechanisms to efficiently handle large inputs and outputs such as images, audio and video.
claim: 作者还表示计划将 Transformer 扩展到文本以外的输入输出模态，并研究局部受限注意力机制以高效处理图像、音频和视频等大输入输出 [S7.p3]。

quote: They cannot easily expand or revise their memory, can’t straightforwardly provide insight into their predictions, and may produce “hallucinations”.
claim: 论文关注预训练语言模型在知识密集型任务上的不足：它们难以扩展或修正记忆、难以提供预测依据，并可能产生“幻觉” [S1.p1]。

quote: They cannot easily expand or revise their memory, can’t straightforwardly provide insight into their predictions, and may produce “hallucinations”.
claim: 已有结合参数与非参数记忆的模型（REALM、ORQA）仅探索了开放域抽取式问答，本文希望将这种混合记忆引入序列到序列模型 [S1.p1]。

quote: We explore RAG models, which use the input sequence $x$ to retrieve text documents $z$ and use them as additional context when generating the target sequence $y$.
claim: RAG 使用输入序列检索文本文档，并将其作为生成目标序列的额外上下文 [S2.p1]。

quote: We explore RAG models, which use the input sequence $x$ to retrieve text documents $z$ and use them as additional context when generating the target sequence $y$.
claim: 模型包含检索器 p_η(z|x)（基于 DPR 的双编码器）和生成器 p_θ(y_i|x,z,y_{1:i-1})（BART-large）[S2.p1][S2.SS2.p1][S2.SS3.p1]。

quote: The retrieval component $p_{\eta}(z|x)$ is based on DPR.
claim: 模型包含检索器 p_η(z|x)（基于 DPR 的双编码器）和生成器 p_θ(y_i|x,z,y_{1:i-1})（BART-large）[S2.p1][S2.SS2.p1][S2.SS3.p1]。

quote: We use BART-large, a pre-trained seq2seq transformer with 400M parameters.
claim: 模型包含检索器 p_η(z|x)（基于 DPR 的双编码器）和生成器 p_θ(y_i|x,z,y_{1:i-1})（BART-large）[S2.p1][S2.SS2.p1][S2.SS3.p1]。

quote: In one approach, RAG-Sequence, the model uses the same document to predict each target token.
claim: 检索文档被视为隐变量，通过 top-K 近似进行边缘化，分为 RAG-Sequence（整段序列使用同一文档）和 RAG-Token（每个 token 可使用不同文档）[S2.p2]。

quote: We jointly train the retriever and generator components without any direct supervision on what document should be retrieved.
claim: 训练时联合优化检索器与生成器，不直接监督应检索哪个文档，并保持文档编码器与索引固定，仅微调查询编码器和 BART 生成器 [S2.SS4.p1]。

quote: For all experiments, we use a single Wikipedia dump for our non-parametric knowledge source.
claim: 所有实验使用 2018 年 12 月的 Wikipedia dump，每篇文章切分为 100 词块，共 21M 文档，并用 FAISS 构建 MIPS 索引 [S3.p1]。

quote: For all experiments, we use a single Wikipedia dump for our non-parametric knowledge source.
claim: 训练时检索 top k 文档，k∈{5,10}，测试时 k 由开发集确定 [S3.p1]。

quote: We consider four popular open-domain QA datasets: Natural Questions (NQ), TriviaQA (TQA). WebQuestions (WQ) and CuratedTrec (CT).
claim: 任务包括四个开放域 QA 数据集（NQ、TriviaQA、WebQuestions、CuratedTrec）[S3.SS1.p1]、MSMARCO NLG 抽象式问答 [S3.SS2.p1]、Jeopardy 问题生成 [S3.SS3.p1] 以及 FEVER 事实核查 [S3.SS4.p1]。

quote: To test RAG’s natural language generation (NLG) in a knowledge-intensive setting, we use the MSMARCO NLG task v2.1.

quote: In this paper, we present a novel deep-learning approach for measuring stellar rotation periods using Kepler light curves.
claim: 论文旨在解决从 Kepler 光变曲线中准确、稳健地测量大量恒星自转周期的问题 [S1.p1][S1.p3]。

quote: One shortcoming of classical methods is their inability to provide uncertainty estimates for predictions, which are essential for evaluating the reliability of the results.
claim: 作者指出，经典方法的一个缺点是难以提供预测的不确定性估计，而这对评估结果可靠性至关重要 [S1.SS1.p1]。

quote: To train the model, we used a 2-step pipeline; First, we trained the model, without the prediction head, in a self-supervised fashion, with Kepler samples.
claim: 训练采用两阶段流程：先在 Kepler 样本上进行自监督对比学习（SSL），再以模拟数据集进行监督训练（SBSL） [S4.SS2.p1]。

quote: We pre-processed each sample in the following way: First, we cut the first 200 days to reach a steady state for spot evolution.

quote: To create a dataset for supervised training we used simulated light curves using Butterpy, a python package described in.

quote: This was done on a dataset of 50000 simulated samples of 1000 days that were generated as explained in II.1 and II.2.

quote: We compare our results to the results reported by the Tel-Aviv team in.

claim: 作者还进行了消融实验，比较完整模型、无差分预处理、仅时序分支、仅 Conformer 分支以及仅预测周期等变体 [S4.SS3.p1]。

quote: It can be seen that our results are better for both noisy and noiseless samples.
claim: 在模拟数据上，LightPred 在噪声和无噪声样本上的表现均优于 ACF 和 GPS 方法 [S5.SS1.p2]。

quote: It can be seen that our results are better for both noisy and noiseless samples.
claim: 在有效预测子集上，ACF 的 acc10p 和 acc20p 与 LightPred 相当，但 LightPred 的平均误差显著更低 [S5.SS1.p2]。

quote: For $3<P_{orb}<10$, sp samples are very close to the synchronization line (the gray line at $P_{orb}/P_{rot}=1$) as expected.

quote: Those observations appear to contradict expectations that the SED should be very red throughout the optical to NIR spectrum due to re-emission from hot dust components heated by the AGNs.
claim: 此外，LRDs在λ≳1 μm处SED多样性的原因尚不清楚 [S1.p3]。

claim: 论文提出一个LRDs的SED模型：假设典型AGN的入射辐射被延展尘埃介质包裹，采用类似猎户座星云或某些AGN环境的消光律，用灰消光在λ<3000 Å产生平坦紫外谱，在λ>4000 Å产生红色光学连续谱，无需额外恒星辐射或AGN散射光 [S1.p6][S2.p6]。

quote: Our findings in this work further demonstrate that such gray extinction curves can explain the characteristic v-shaped SEDs of LRDs, as evidenced by accumulated large samples, without considering multiple components such as host galaxies or scattered AGN light.
claim: 论文提出一个LRDs的SED模型：假设典型AGN的入射辐射被延展尘埃介质包裹，采用类似猎户座星云或某些AGN环境的消光律，用灰消光在λ<3000 Å产生平坦紫外谱，在λ>4000 Å产生红色光学连续谱，无需额外恒星辐射或AGN散射光 [S1.p6][S2.p6]。

claim: 论文旨在系统性地刻画重复采样作为推理阶段计算扩展手段的收益，即随着样本预算增加，模型覆盖率如何变化，以及能否从大量样本中识别出正确解 [S1.p3][S1.p5]。

quote: 1. Coverage: As the number of samples increases, what fraction of problems can we solve using any sample that was generated? 2. Precision: How often can we identify correct samples from our collection of generations?

claim: 对于 DeepSeek-R1，作者采用多阶段框架，整合拒绝采样、强化学习和监督微调，并引入语言一致性奖励以缓解语言混杂问题 [S1.p3][S3.SS2.SSS1.p1]。

quote: we introduce a language consistency reward during RL training, which is calculated as the proportion of target language words in the CoT.
claim: 对于 DeepSeek-R1，作者采用多阶段框架，整合拒绝采样、强化学习和监督微调，并引入语言一致性奖励以缓解语言混杂问题 [S1.p3][S3.SS2.SSS1.p1]。

quote: We evaluate our models on MMLU, MMLU-Redux, MMLU-Pro, C-Eval, and CMMLU, IFEval, FRAMES, GPQA Diamond, SimpleQA, C-SimpleQA, SWE-Bench Verified, Aider, LiveCodeBench (2024-08 – 2025-01), Codeforces, Chinese National High School Mathematics Olympiad (CNMO 2024), and American Invitational Mathematics Examination 2024 (AIME 2024).
claim: 论文在 MMLU、MMLU-Redux、MMLU-Pro、C-Eval、CMMLU、IFEval、FRAMES、GPQA Diamond、SimpleQA、C-SimpleQA、SWE-Bench Verified、Aider、LiveCodeBench、Codeforces、CNMO 2024 和 AIME 2024 等基准上评估模型 [S4.p1]。

quote: Reasoning RL data includes four categories: mathematics, coding, STEM, and logic problems. In addition, we also incorporate general RL data to improve the helpfulness and harmlessness of the model in the training of DeepSeek-R1. All questions are in Chinese or English.
claim: 训练使用数学、编程、STEM 和逻辑推理数据，以及通用数据，所有问题为中文或英文 [A2.SS3.SSS1.p1]。

quote: we use a sampling temperature of 0.6 and a top-p value of 0.95 to generate k responses (typically between 4 and 64, depending on the test set size) for each question.
claim: 评估采用 pass@k 设置，采样温度 0.6，top-p 0.95，对 AIME 和 GPQA 使用 k=64，MATH 和 CodeForces 使用 k=16，LCB 使用 k=8 [A4.SS1.SSS0.Px4.p2]。

quote: the average pass@1 score on AIME 2024 shows a significant increase, jumping from an initial 15.6% to 77.9%.
claim: DeepSeek-R1-Zero 在 AIME 2024 上的 pass@1 从初始 15.6% 提升至 77.9%，结合自一致性解码可达 86.7% [S2.SS3.p2]。

quote: DeepSeek-R1-Zero increasingly exhibits advanced reasoning strategies such as reflective reasoning and systematic exploration of alternative solutions
claim: 训练过程中模型自然涌现出反思、验证等高级推理行为，并出现“aha moment” [S2.SS3.p5]。

quote: The primary advancements in the final DeepSeek-R1 were in general instruction-following and user-preference benchmarks, with AlpacaEval 2.0 improving by 25% and ArenaHard by 17%.
claim: DeepSeek-R1 在多阶段训练后，在推理和通用基准上均取得提升，最终 AlpacaEval 2.0 提升 25%，ArenaHard 提升 17% [S4.p3]。

quote: These distilled models exhibit strong reasoning capabilities, surpassing the performance of their original instruction-tuned counterparts.
claim: 蒸馏后的小模型推理能力超过其原始指令微调版本 [S1.p4]。

quote: Currently, the structural output capabilities of DeepSeek-R1 remain suboptimal compared to existing models. Moreover, DeepSeek-R1 cannot leverage tools, such as search engines and calculators, to improve the performance of output.
claim: 作者明确承认 DeepSeek-R1 存在多项局限：结构化输出能力欠佳，且无法利用搜索引擎、计算器等工具 [S6.p3]；

quote: there remains room for further optimization in terms of token efficiency, as instances of excessive reasoning—manifested as overthinking—are still observed in response to simpler questions.
claim: token 效率仍有优化空间，简单问题上存在过度思考 [S6.p4]；

quote: DeepSeek-R1 is currently optimized for Chinese and English, which may result in language mixing issues when handling queries in other languages.
claim: 目前主要优化中英文，处理其他语言时可能出现语言混杂 [S6.p5]；

quote: When evaluating DeepSeek-R1, we observe that it is sensitive to prompts. Few-shot prompting consistently degrades its performance.
claim: 对提示敏感，few-shot 提示会持续降低性能 [S6.p6]；

quote: Due to the long evaluation times, which impact the efficiency of the RL process, large-scale RL has not been applied extensively in software engineering tasks. As a result, DeepSeek-R1 has not demonstrated a huge improvement over DeepSeek-V3 on software engineering benchmarks.
claim: 由于评估耗时影响 RL 效率，软件工程任务未大规模应用 RL，性能提升有限 [S6.p7]。

quote: If the reward signal is assigned by a model instead of predefined rules, it becomes more susceptible to exploitation as training progresses, which means the policy model may find shortcuts to hack the reward model.
claim: 此外，纯 RL 方法本身面临奖励黑客挑战，对于无法构建可靠奖励模型的复杂任务，扩展纯 RL 仍是开放问题 [S6.p9]。

quote: Thus, we ask: what is the simplest approach to achieve both test-time scaling and strong reasoning performance?
claim: 论文要解决的问题是：在 OpenAI o1 未公开方法、众多复现尝试均未公开复现出清晰测试时扩展行为的情况下，找到实现测试时扩展和强推理性能的最简单方法 [S1.p1]。

quote: Thus, we ask: what is the simplest approach to achieve both test-time scaling and strong reasoning performance?
claim: 其动机在于测试时扩展这一新范式已被 o1 验证有效，但缺乏透明的方法 [S1.p1]。

quote: We show that training on only 1,000 samples with next-token prediction and controlling thinking duration via a simple test-time technique we refer to as budget forcing leads to a strong reasoning model
claim: 论文提出两个简单方法：一是通过质量、难度、多样性三个准则筛选出 1,000 个问题及推理轨迹构成 s1K 数据集 [S1.p2][S2.SS2.p1]；

quote: we go through three stages of filtering to arrive at a minimal set of 1,000 samples relying on our three guiding data principles: Quality, Difficulty, and Diversity.
claim: 论文提出两个简单方法：一是通过质量、难度、多样性三个准则筛选出 1,000 个问题及推理轨迹构成 s1K 数据集 [S1.p2][S2.SS2.p1]；

quote: We show that training on only 1,000 samples with next-token prediction and controlling thinking duration via a simple test-time technique we refer to as budget forcing leads to a strong reasoning model
claim: 二是提出预算强制（budget forcing），在解码时通过强制插入思考结束标记或抑制该标记并追加“Wait”来控制思考 token 数量 [S1.p2][S3.SS1.SSS0.Px1.p1]。

quote: We propose a simple decoding-time intervention by forcing a maximum and/or minimum number of thinking tokens.
claim: 二是提出预算强制（budget forcing），在解码时通过强制插入思考结束标记或抑制该标记并追加“Wait”来控制思考 token 数量 [S1.p2][S3.SS1.SSS0.Px1.p1]。

quote: We show that training on only 1,000 samples with next-token prediction and controlling thinking duration via a simple test-time technique we refer to as budget forcing leads to a strong reasoning model
claim: 核心思想是用极少量样本进行监督微调，并在测试时通过预算强制控制计算量 [S1.p2]。

quote: We perform supervised finetuning on Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct using s1K to obtain our model s1-32B
claim: 论文在 Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct 上使用 s1K 进行监督微调，训练在 16 块 H100 GPU 上耗时 26 分钟 [S4.SS1.SSS0.Px1.p1]。

quote: We select three representative reasoning benchmarks widely used in the field: AIME24 has 30 problems
claim: 评估使用三个推理基准：AIME24（30 题）、MATH500（500 题）和 GPQA Diamond（198 题），采用温度 0 的贪婪解码，测量准确率 [S4.SS1.SSS0.Px2.p1]。

quote: Here we test the importance of combining them and the overall efficacy of our selection.
claim: 此外还进行了数据消融（随机、仅多样性、仅难度、全量 59K）和测试时扩展方法消融（预算强制、条件长度控制、拒绝采样） [S5.SS1.p1][S5.SS2.SSS0.Px1.p1][S5.SS2.SSS0.Px2.p1]。

quote: In Table 3 we compare the test-time scaling methods we have introduced in §3.
claim: 此外还进行了数据消融（随机、仅多样性、仅难度、全量 59K）和测试时扩展方法消融（预算强制、条件长度控制、拒绝采样） [S5.SS1.p1][S5.SS2.SSS0.Px1.p1][S5.SS2.SSS0.Px2.p1]。

quote: we find that simply sampling until the generation fits a specific length leads to an inverse scaling trend
claim: 此外还进行了数据消融（随机、仅多样性、仅难度、全量 59K）和测试时扩展方法消融（预算强制、条件长度控制、拒绝采样） [S5.SS1.p1][S5.SS2.SSS0.Px1.p1][S5.SS2.SSS0.Px2.p1]。

quote: our model s1-32B exceeds o1-preview on competition math questions by up to 27% (MATH and AIME24)
claim: s1-32B 在竞赛数学问题上超过 o1-preview 最高达 27%（MATH 和 AIME24） [abstract]。

quote: our model s1-32B exceeds o1-preview on competition math questions by up to 27% (MATH and AIME24)
claim: 通过预算强制，s1-32B 在 AIME24 上从 50% 外推至 57% [abstract]。

quote: We find that s1-32B is the most sample-efficient open data reasoning model.
claim: s1-32B 是最样本高效的开放数据推理模型，仅用 1,000 个样本就显著优于基础模型 [S4.SS2.SSS0.Px2.p1]。

quote: Random selection, selecting samples with the longest reasoning traces, or only selecting maximally diverse samples all lead to significantly worse performance (around $-$ 30% on AIME24 on average).
claim: 数据消融表明，结合质量、难度、多样性三个准则至关重要，随机选择、仅选最长推理轨迹或仅选最大多样性均导致性能显著下降（AIME24 平均约 -30%） [S1.p3]。

quote: we find that budget forcing provides perfect control, good scaling, and leads to our best AIME24 score.
claim: 预算强制提供了完美的控制、良好的扩展斜率和最佳 AIME24 分数 [S5.SS2.SSS0.Px1.p1]。

quote: it has two key limitations when scaling further: it eventually flattens out ( Figure 4), and the context window of the underlying language model constrains it.
claim: 作者明确承认预算强制在进一步扩展时有两个关键限制：最终会趋于平缓，且受底层语言模型的上下文窗口约束 [S6.SS2.SSS0.Px2.p1]。

quote: Suppressing the end-of-thinking token delimiter too often can lead the model into repetitive loops instead of continued reasoning.
claim: 此外，抑制思考结束标记过于频繁可能导致模型陷入重复循环而非继续推理 [S4.SS2.SSS0.Px1.p1]。

quote: Complex reasoning has long been considered one of the most challenging capabilities to instill in large language models (LLMs).
claim: 作者指出，传统范式基于两个假设——掌握复杂认知过程需要大量监督示范，且监督微调主要导致记忆而非真正泛化 [S1.p1]。

quote: We argue this data-intensive paradigm may no longer be necessary.
claim: 作者认为这种数据密集型范式可能不再必要，因为现代基础模型在预训练中已包含大量数学内容，挑战已从知识获取转变为知识激发 [S1.p2]。

quote: In foundation models where domain knowledge has been comprehensively encoded during pre-training, sophisticated reasoning capabilities can emerge through minimal but precisely orchestrated demonstrations of cognitive processes.
claim: 论文提出 LIMO 假说，认为在预训练已全面编码领域知识的基础模型中，复杂推理可通过少量但精确编排的认知过程示范涌现，其两个前提是模型参数中潜在具备前置知识，以及推理链能将复杂问题分解为详细逻辑步骤 [S3.p1]。

quote: Problems that were successfully solved in only 1–3 out of 32 attempts were retained, yielding a refined dataset of 2,125 problems
claim: 作者构建了一个多阶段数据筛选流程：先用短 CoT 模型过滤简单题，再用更强推理模型以 32 次采样成功率保留 1–3 次成功的难题，得到 2,125 题的 LIMO-Pool [S3.SS1.SSS1.p3]。

quote: we implemented a rule-based scoring system that calculated weighted metrics for each dimension.
claim: 随后用三个推理模型生成解答，并按详细推理、自我验证、探索性方法、自适应粒度四个维度进行规则打分，选出每题最高分解答并取前 800 条构成 LIMO 数据集 [S3.SS1.SSS2.p6][S3.SS1.SSS2.p7]。

quote: we selected the highest-scoring solution for each problem, ranked these pairs by quality score, and extracted the top 800 to form the LIMO Dataset.
claim: 随后用三个推理模型生成解答，并按详细推理、自我验证、探索性方法、自适应粒度四个维度进行规则打分，选出每题最高分解答并取前 800 条构成 LIMO 数据集 [S3.SS1.SSS2.p6][S3.SS1.SSS2.p7]。

quote: We fine-tune Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct using supervised fine-tuning on our LIMO dataset.
claim: 训练上对 Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct 进行全参数监督微调，使用 DeepSpeed ZeRO-3、FlashAttention-2、学习率 5.0e-6、余弦衰减、无 warmup、15 个 epoch、batch size 64 [S4.p2]。

quote: Our primary evaluation suite includes several well-established mathematical competitions and benchmarks: the American Invitational Mathematics Examination (AIME24), MATH500, and the American Mathematics Competitions (AMC23).
claim: 论文在域内基准 AIME24、MATH500、AMC23 上评估，并在分布外基准上测试，包括 OlympiadBench、中文多语言基准 CHMath、Gaokao、Kaoyan、GradeSchool，以及多学科基准 Minerva 和 GPQA [S5.SS0.SSS0.Px1.p1][S5.SS0.SSS0.Px2.p1]。

quote: we include diverse mathematical competitions like OlympiadBench to test performance on different mathematical challenges.
claim: 论文在域内基准 AIME24、MATH500、AMC23 上评估，并在分布外基准上测试，包括 OlympiadBench、中文多语言基准 CHMath、Gaokao、Kaoyan、GradeSchool，以及多学科基准 Minerva 和 GPQA [S5.SS0.SSS0.Px1.p1][S5.SS0.SSS0.Px2.p1]。

quote: We evaluate performance using the pass@1 metric in a zero-shot chain-of-thought setting across all benchmarks.
claim: 评估采用零样本思维链下的 pass@1 指标，大基准用贪心解码单样本，小于 50 题的小基准生成 4 个样本并计算无偏 pass@1，最大输出长度 32,768 token [S5.SS0.SSS0.Px3.p1]。

quote: These include OpenAI-o1-preview, a large language model that has demonstrated advanced mathematical reasoning abilities across various complex tasks; QwQ-32B-Preview
claim: 对比基线包括 OpenAI-o1-preview、QwQ-32B-Preview、Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct，以及用 OpenThoughts-114k 和 NuminaMath-100k 微调的模型 [S6.SS1.p1][S6.SS1.p2]。

quote: These comparative datasets include OpenThoughts-114k, a synthetic reasoning dataset containing 114k examples
claim: 对比基线包括 OpenAI-o1-preview、QwQ-32B-Preview、Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct，以及用 OpenThoughts-114k 和 NuminaMath-100k 微调的模型 [S6.SS1.p1][S6.SS1.p2]。

quote: For AIME24, LIMO achieves 63.3% accuracy, outperforming QwQ-32B-Preview (50.0%) and OpenAI-o1-preview (44.6%) by significant margins.
claim: 在域内任务上，LIMO 在 AIME24 达到 63.3%，超过 QwQ-32B-Preview 的 50.0% 和 OpenAI-o1-preview 的 44.6%；MATH500 达到 95.6%，AMC23 达到 96.3% [S6.SS2.SSS0.Px1.p1]。

quote: On OlympiadBench, LIMO achieves 67.6% accuracy, significantly outperforming QwQ-32B-Preview (58.5%) and the base model (45.3%).
claim: 在分布外任务上，LIMO 在 OlympiadBench 达到 67.6%，CHMath 84.2%，GradeSchool 76.2%，GPQA 70.7% [S6.SS2.SSS0.Px2.p1]。

quote: NuminaMath-100k shows significant degradation (32.3% vs. base model’s 49.9%) due to uncurated reasoning chains, while OpenThoughts-114k achieves suboptimal results (58.3%)
claim: 尽管基线数据集规模更大，NuminaMath-100k 出现明显退化（32.3%），OpenThoughts-114k 为 58.3%，而 LIMO 的 800 题达到 78.1% [S6.SS2.SSS0.Px3.p1]。

quote: LIMO achieves the highest average performance of 78.1% across all benchmarks, substantially outperforming OpenAI-o1-preview, QwQ-32B-Preview, and other baselines.
claim: LIMO 在所有基准上的平均性能为 78.1%，超过 OpenAI-o1-preview、QwQ-32B-Preview 等基线 [S6.SS2.SSS0.Px4.p1]。

quote: L5-trained models achieve highest results on both AIME24 and MATH500, with performance decreasing consistently with each quality level.
claim: 分析显示推理链质量与模型性能正相关，L5 训练模型在 AIME24 和 MATH500 上最高 [S6.SS3.SSS1.p3]；

quote: Results in Figure 4 show that modifying problem selection alone leads to 16% accuracy improvement on AIME2024, reaching 51.5%.
claim: 仅改变问题难度即可在 AIME2024 上带来 16% 准确率提升，Advanced-500 微调模型在 MATH500 上达到 91.2% [S6.SS3.SSS2.p1]；

quote: LIMO (built on Qwen2.5) achieves 63.3% accuracy on AIME2024, a 54.1 percentage point improvement over Qwen1.5’s 9.2%.
claim: 预训练模型选择影响显著，LIMO 在 AIME2024 上比 Qwen1.5 高 54.1 个百分点 [S6.SS3.SSS3.p2]；

quote: The performance on AIME24 shows a marked increase with model size, rising from 2.5 for the 3B model to 68.3 for the 72B model.
claim: 模型规模增大时 AIME24 性能从 3B 的 2.5 升至 72B 的 68.3，但 32B 与 72B 在 MATH500 上差异很小 [S6.SS3.SSS4.p1]；

quote: Fine-tuning with just 400 samples yields dramatic improvement over the base model, increasing AIME24 accuracy from 16.5 to 57.5 and MATH500 accuracy from 79.4 to 94.8.
claim: 仅 400 样本即可将 AIME24 从 16.5 提升至 57.5，超过 800 样本后收益递减 [S6.SS3.SSS5.p2]。

quote: though the lower bound for maintaining effective performance remains an open question.
claim: 作者在样本效率分析中指出，维持有效性能所需的最小样本量下界仍是一个开放问题 [S6.SS3.SSS5.p1]。

quote: Future work could explore active learning strategies to further optimize sample efficiency.
claim: 作者还提出未来工作可探索主动学习策略以进一步优化样本效率 [S6.SS3.SSS5.p2]。

quote: In this iteration of Qwen2.5-VL, we are committed to exploring fine-grained perception capabilities, aiming to establish a robust foundation for LVLMs and create an agentic amplifier for real-world applications.
claim: 论文旨在探索细粒度感知能力，为 LVLM 建立坚实基础，并打造面向真实应用的智能体放大器 [S1.p1]。

quote: vision-language models currently face developmental bottlenecks, including computational complexity, limited contextual understanding, poor fine-grained visual perception, and inconsistent performance across varied sequence length.
claim: 当前视觉语言模型面临计算复杂度、上下文理解有限、细粒度视觉感知差以及不同序列长度下性能不一致等发展瓶颈 [S1.p3]。

quote: The overall model architecture of Qwen2.5-VL consists of three components:
claim: Qwen2.5-VL 的架构由视觉编码器、基于 MLP 的视觉-语言合并器和以 Qwen2.5 LLM 初始化的语言模型三部分组成 [S2.SS1.p1][S2.SS1.p2][S2.SS1.p4]。

quote: The model is initialized with pre-trained weights from the Qwen2.5 LLM.
claim: Qwen2.5-VL 的架构由视觉编码器、基于 MLP 的视觉-语言合并器和以 Qwen2.5 LLM 初始化的语言模型三部分组成 [S2.SS1.p1][S2.SS1.p2][S2.SS1.p4]。

quote: we adopt a simple yet effective approach to compress the feature sequences before feeding them into the large language model (LLM).
claim: Qwen2.5-VL 的架构由视觉编码器、基于 MLP 的视觉-语言合并器和以 Qwen2.5 LLM 初始化的语言模型三部分组成 [S2.SS1.p1][S2.SS1.p2][S2.SS1.p4]。

quote: we incorporate 2D-RoPE and window attention to support native input resolutions while accelerating the computation of the entire visual encoder.
claim: 视觉编码器采用重新设计的 ViT，引入 2D-RoPE 和窗口注意力以支持原生分辨率并加速计算，大部分层使用窗口注意力，仅四层使用全自注意力 [S2.SS1.p3][S2.SS1.SSS1.p1]。

quote: only four layers employ full self-attention, while the remaining layers utilize windowed attention with a maximum window size of 112×112
claim: 视觉编码器采用重新设计的 ViT，引入 2D-RoPE 和窗口注意力以支持原生分辨率并加速计算，大部分层使用窗口注意力，仅四层使用全自注意力 [S2.SS1.p3][S2.SS1.SSS1.p1]。

quote: our model directly uses the actual dimensions of the input image to represent bounding boxes, points, and other spatial features.
claim: 模型在空间上动态将不同尺寸图像转换为相应长度的 token 序列，直接使用实际尺寸表示边界框和点；在时间上引入动态 FPS 训练和绝对时间编码，将 MRoPE 的时间 ID 与绝对时间对齐 [S2.SS1.SSS2.p2][S2.SS1.SSS2.p3][S2.SS1.SSS3.p3]。

quote: Qwen2.5-VL incorporates dynamic frame rate (FPS) training and absolute time encoding.
claim: 模型在空间上动态将不同尺寸图像转换为相应长度的 token 序列，直接使用实际尺寸表示边界框和点；在时间上引入动态 FPS 训练和绝对时间编码，将 MRoPE 的时间 ID 与绝对时间对齐 [S2.SS1.SSS2.p2][S2.SS1.SSS2.p3][S2.SS1.SSS3.p3]。
